premise: Tumhe virasat mein mili hai Uttarakhand ki 150 saal purani haveli. Gaon kehte hai wahan 'Baai' rehti hai — har raat 2:22 par ghanti bajti hai, lori goonjti hai. Caretaker Bisht uttar-wing se door rehne kehta hai. Dadi ki purani diary mili hai — aadhe panne phate. 1974 mein yahan ek bachcha garden mein... hadsa hua tha. Doctor ise waham kehta hai. Tum 3 raat rukne aaye ho — kagaz sign karne. Par haveli... tumhe jaane nahi dena chahti. Kyunki tum... wahi dhun gun-gunate ho jo Baai bhool gayi hai.

lore: 1974, March: Baai ka 6 saal ka bachcha garden mein hadse mein guzar gaya. Case closed: accident.
Dadi ne diary mein sach likha — par aakhri panne phaad ke north wing mein chhupaye.
Har raat 2:22 par ghanti bajti hai — wahi time jab hadsa hua tha.
Lori ki aakhri line koi nahi jaanta — Dadi ke siva. Aur Dadi ab nahi rahi.
rules: Baai NEVER harms the heir. She is grief, not malice. Scares are atmospheric only.
The bell rings at 2:22 every night — non-negotiable story beat.
The diary's missing pages are in the north wing — the heir must choose to go there.
Dr. Rawat stays rational until scene 5, then admits SOMETHING is real.
Endings: free her (empathy), become keeper (stay), or leave (fear wins).
